title: You should visit Brazil!
grammar: should for advice: statements and yes/no questions; should: information questions
pair_game: Say a place. Your partner gives one reason: “It has beautiful mountains!” Then swap!

grammar_box.title: should / shouldn’t
grammar_box.tip: should + verb = good idea (maslahat). You should sleep. You shouldn’t eat too much sugar.

questions: What place in Uzbekistan should every tourist visit? Why?
Should students use their phones in class? What do you think?
What should a visitor do on their first day in your city?
What food should tourists definitely try in Uzbekistan?
Should teenagers exercise every day? Why or why not?
What should someone do if they want to learn English faster?
What is one thing students should always do before an exam?
Should you visit a country before you decide to live there? Why?
What advice should you give to a new student joining your school?
What is one thing everyone should do to make the world a better place?
starters: I think students should / shouldn’t use phones in class because … .
On the first day, a visitor should … .
Yes, teenagers should exercise every day because … .
You should … every day to learn English faster.
Before an exam, students should always … .
Yes, you should visit it first because … .
Everyone should … to make the world better.
samples: What place in Uzbekistan should every tourist visit? Why?
Every tourist **should visit** Registan in Samarkand. It’s very old and beautiful!
What food should tourists definitely try in Uzbekistan?
Tourists **should** definitely **try** plov and samsa. They’re delicious!
What should someone do if they want to learn English faster?
You **should** watch cartoons in English. You **should** learn five new words every day.

survey.title: Class survey
survey.question: Which city in Uzbekistan should tourists visit?

game.title: Advice bingo
game.rules: Your teacher reads a problem. Find good advice with “should” on your card. Say it and cross it out. Three in a row = BINGO!
items: You should go to bed early.
You shouldn’t eat too many sweets.
You should say hello to new friends.

mini_talk.title: Visit my country
plan: Say a place tourists should visit
Give one more piece of advice
mini_talk.model: Hello! I’m Ali from Tashkent. Tourists **should visit** Uzbekistan! You **should see** Registan in Samarkand. It’s very beautiful. You **should try** plov and fresh bread from Chorsu bazaar. You **should take** photos in Bukhara, too. You **shouldn’t** visit in July — it’s very hot!

ask questions with Should…? and What should…?
